principles: Keep DONE as a lifecycle terminal state and add outcome semantics beside it.
Make user-facing progress labels impossible to confuse with technical completion.
Preserve existing gate strictness and old story/evidence compatibility.
Prefer small schema extensions over hard-coded project-specific classifications.
drivers: Users misread DONE percentage as technical completion.
Blocked spike stories need an honest classified outcome language.
Existing Koala lifecycle and metadata must remain backward compatible.

options.name: A: Add outcomeKind/verdict display layer without changing phases
pros: Works with legacy DONE stories via defaults
Can be tested in dashboard/session/coverage renderers
cons: DONE still exists as lifecycle term, so labels must be precise
Requires summary/evidence schema and docs updates

options.name: B: Split DONE into DONE_SUCCESS/DONE_BLOCKED/DONE_AUDIT phases
cons: High migration risk for story_advance, cleanup, audit trigger, and existing story data
More phase transitions to teach users

options.name: C: Only change dashboard wording, no schema change
pros: Could reduce one visible confusion quickly
cons: Does not solve blocked spike evidence semantics

chosen: A: Add outcomeKind/verdict display layer without changing phases
rationale: Option A addresses both dashboard and spike evidence confusion while keeping lifecycle gates stable and preserving historical story compatibility.

preMortem.scenario: OutcomeKind becomes a new bypass around DONE gates
preMortem.trigger: Implementation treats blocked/audit outcome as coverage without explicit evidence or summary
preMortem.consequence: Stories could appear accepted without real validation
preMortem.mitigation: Keep gate pass/fail behavior unchanged and test that verdict is display/coverage semantics only when evidence is explicit

preMortem.scenario: Dashboard still reads as a single percent
preMortem.trigger: Rendering keeps N/M DONE as the headline without naming lifecycle progress
preMortem.consequence: Users continue mistaking process completion for technical success
preMortem.mitigation: Render lifecycle progress separately from outcome breakdown

preMortem.scenario: Legacy stories render as unknown and create noise
preMortem.consequence: Existing projects look worse after upgrade
preMortem.mitigation: Default legacy DONE stories to success unless summary outcomeKind says blocked/audit-only
